description.value: Boho House is a self-catering vacation rental listed on Airbnb on Bowen Island, BC, a short ferry ride from West Vancouver. The Airbnb listing title references a 'Sanctuary Home & Spa' experience, suggesting a wellness-oriented property. As an unstaffed short-term rental, it likely functions as a self-check-in home rather than a traditional guest house with cycling support services.

No amenity, storage, or contact details could be extracted from the website content, so all criteria must be null. OSM tags provide the address and Instagram handle but no cycling-relevant amenities.
